name: Balak
overview: The Scripture presents Balak as the king of Moab who, fearing the growing power of Israel, sought to use Balaam's divination to curse God's chosen people. Balak sent messengers with rewards to entice Balaam to come and curse Israel, believing that cursing them would grant him victory and drive them out of the land. Despite Balak's persistent efforts, including sending more honorable princes, the narrative highlights the futility of opposing God's blessing on Israel through human schemes.
